name: sign-in
title: Sign in
description: Email and password sign-in with a passkey option. A centred card on narrow containers, a two-column layout with a brand panel on wide ones.
docs: Render <SignIn /> inside your ThemeScope (it follows the theme, scheme, density and locale around it). Its copy and data live in components/sign-in/sign-in.content.ts: pass your own object as `content` to translate or rebrand it.
